Establish Contact

"The third side of the coin requires new lines of communication."

Whether you are a fellow analyst, a reader with a compelling data point, or someone who has spotted an overlooked pattern in history, your insights are welcome. Xocu remains a private operation, but the network is always open to collaborative minds.

How to Reach Out

  • The Secure Inbox

    For secure inquiries, data sharing, or feedback, dispatch an email directly to: support@xocu.com

  • The Transmission Portal

    Alternatively, utilize the encrypted submission form below to send a direct message into the archives.

Inquiry Directives

To ensure your message bypasses our filters, please categorize your subject line:

  • [Data/Corrections]

    For verified corrections to articles or new maps.

  • [Intel/Leads]

    For historical, scientific, or geopolitical patterns worth investigating.

  • [Syndicate]

    For content sharing, translation requests, or collaboration.

Note: Due to the high volume of automated noise across the digital landscape, responses are sent selectively. If your data holds weight, you will receive a transmission back from Xocu.
